what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Cape Verde in all host countries: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 79 Cape Verdean asylum seekers, and the United States hosted 26.6% of them.
After the United States, the largest hosts are Brazil, Italy and Canada.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Cape Verde, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2017 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2000 at 13 asylum seekers, and the figure was at its highest, 273, at the end of 2021.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
